verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime offers a Postman Collection for exploring its API, which is a machine-readable artifact. Its per-endpoint reference pages also carry 'summary:' fields that look generated from an OpenAPI-style source. However, a probe of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate, so no downloadable OpenAPI spec is evidenced. Missing for 10: a publicly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, documentation of where to download the spec or collection, and independent confirmation that the Postman Collection covers the full API.
